text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
As expected,
she's on a completely different level.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!!!
choice_data_list: (…! Here it comes!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!?
What is that late burst of speed...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: Whoa... That was an incredible race to watch! Especially Orfevre...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't anywhere near a Make Debut level of racing.
As expected of Dream Journey's sister...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...No, even more so than Dream Journey...
Could it be...?!"

The murmurs of the fans sound distant.
That's just how breathtaking Orfevre's running was... and my heart won't stop pounding.
choice_data_list: (When you get back, I'm going to praise you so much!)

text_block_list.text:
—...Or so I thought.
Going against the flow of Umamusume returning to the tunnel...
for some reason, she turned back.
choice_data_list: (O-Orfevre...?)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...My subjects.
Do not grow soft.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You have beheld the King's run.
Where is your gratitude, your applause?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—You stand in the presence of the King.
Quickly, kneel!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: Wh-What is that girl even saying?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... in the paddock too,
they were rambling about some king..."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Still, somehow... somehow...!
I feel like I need to kneel down...?!"
choice_data_list: (I-I've got to do something!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Please leave this to me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
To ensure Or's satisfaction,
I shall go and ask for the fans' cooperation.
Leaving it to her would probably turn out fine, but... that would just be the same as before. Right now, I need to fulfill my duties as her Trainer.
choice_data_list: ...No, I'm coming with you!
...No, I'm coming with you too!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Pardon?
choice_data_list: Because I'm Orfe's trainer!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Let us be on our way, then.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Unacceptable. Make every single one of them bow their heads.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"They told me they want to give us a standing ovation.
...Right, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: A... A round of applause, pleeeeaaase!!

text_block_list.name: Broadcast Audio
text_block_list.text:
"An extraordinary atmosphere has enveloped the Niigata Racecourse...
Orfevre seems poised to draw quite a lot of attention."

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Another incredible girl has shown up.
Though with that much personality, she might—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
—Ahahaha, woah, that's so cool!!
This girl named Orfevre! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text: !? W-Who the heck are you—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
Super strong, and, what do they call it, arrogant as hell?
Being totally wild like that is so cool.
...Yeah, you only live once anyway!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
Alright, decided! The next band name is...
"Orfevre"!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
Play all the music you love, sing your heart out!
—I'm gonna go wild too!

And so, with Dream Journey's help,
we somehow managed to satisfy Orfevre...
and made it back to the waiting room.
choice_data_list: (They ended up getting a huge round of applause...)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Where is my sister?
choice_data_list: They're arranging our ride back.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I see.
...And what about you?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Stunned, are you?
Is that all you have to say?

...That's not it. Naturally,
I'm staying behind with her
to do the necessary work as a Trainer.
choice_data_list: First off... that was an amazing run!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: I knew it—I want to aim for a GⅠ with you!
I knew it—I want to aim for a GⅠ with you!

text_block_list.text:
With the debut race finished, it was time to decide her next target race.
It was a big task. And given her abilities...
it had to be the pinnacle: a Junior GⅠ race—
choice_data_list: What about the "Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes"?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...The race that Elder Sister won, is it?
Any other reason?"
choice_data_list: You can become the champion of the junior division!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I was utterly dumbfounded.
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You must know.
All I seek is the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
King of the Junior Class...
What of it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Boasting of an inevitable victory.
Is that how a king behaves?"
choice_data_list: Still...

text_block_list.text:
High ability and accumulating experience carry entirely different importance.
Going straight into the Classic Triple Crown with a lack of experience is exceedingly tough.
choice_data_list: (I at least want to run in the race, but...)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Speak.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Before the King,
lay everything bare.
choice_data_list: ...I want to gain more experience to prepare for the real thing.
...I want to gain more experience to prepare for the real thing.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You have a point.
choice_data_list: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: If the mood strikes me, I might just run.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Listen well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
All offerings to the King
must be of the finest quality.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Objects, people... and opinions alike.
Present only that which has reached the utmost precision."

The initial reason I offered was rejected because my understanding of Orfevre was shallow.
While realizing my own immaturity, my motivation begins to boil over.
choice_data_list: (I've got to earn their trust soon!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"—'Orfevre's Unprecedented Debut!?
Taunts Fans, Skips Post-Race Interview'."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa...
That's way too amazing."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Orfevre.
You are my...—
